doc.title: Scott Hamilton interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Woods thanks Hamilton and looks forward to the evening concert.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thank you. This has been informative, and we really look forward to your concert again tonight. I really enjoyed the one last night — the spontaneity and the creativity on stage, was just fabulous.
Thanks a million, I appreciate it.
